item.title: Help She’s Eating A Kebab Out Of My Anus | And Jordan’s Moonlanding
item.description:
William Hanson had a brush with death this week, coming dangerously close to a full knockout on his way to the airport. Meanwhile, Jordan North has discovered Spain’s finest cleaning products and decided they’re better than any aftershave money can buy.


Plus, the boys tackle your burning dilemmas, including delivery drivers doing a poo, whether you should surrender your bed to a guest, and oral explorations of untraditonal zones... Feed: https://feeds.acast.com/public/shows/82de067d-b294-48af-b986-6a14d549f6f4

item.title: MacVoices #26278: Live! - Apple HomeView: First Impressions, Features, and Buying Decisions
item.description: Apple's new HomeView takes center stage (no pun intended) as the panel examines its design, features, pricing, and potential role in the smart home. From tabletop and wall-mounted models to HomeKit integration, FaceTime, calendars, and home automation, the discussion explores practical uses and limitations. Panelists who have already ordered HomeView share their buying decisions, while others question its capabilities, third-party support, and competition... Feed: https://maclevelten.libsyn.com/rss
